sentences.en: Welcome to another Friday Chit Chat.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到又一期的周五闲聊。

sentences.en: I've been holding on to something for a little while, not that long,
sentences.zh: 我憋着一件事有一阵子了，其实也没多久，

sentences.en: but as my BFF, it has been really hard for me not to tell you this, Angela.
sentences.zh: 但作为我的闺蜜，安吉拉，不告诉你真的让我很难受。

sentences.en: I wrote it down because I want to get it right.
sentences.zh: 我把它写下来了，因为我想准确地表达出来。

sentences.en: Even the smallest person can change the course of the future.
sentences.zh: 即使是最渺小的人，也能改变未来的进程。

sentences.en: Have you been watching The Mandalorian?
sentences.zh: 你最近在看《曼达洛人》吗？

sentences.en: You're not talking about Baby Yoda?
sentences.zh: 你说的不是尤达宝宝吧？

sentences.en: I am so sad right now.
Can I have it one more time in the same delivery?
sentences.zh: 能用同样的语气再来一遍吗？

sentences.en: Even the smallest person can change the course of the future.
sentences.zh: 即使是最渺小的人，也能改变未来的进程。

sentences.en: It's a movie about friendship and a quest and adventure.
sentences.zh: 那是一部关于友谊、探索和冒险的电影。

sentences.en: And he's talking about The Hobbit.
sentences.zh: 而且他说的就是《霍比特人》里的台词。
因为弗罗多要把戒指扔进火里。

sentences.en: Wait, when did you watch it?
And lady, as this movie is unfolding, I know I said I watched the first seven minutes, and
sentences.zh: 而且，亲爱的，随着电影情节展开，我知道我说过我只看了前七分钟，

sentences.en: the first seven minutes is like being in a classroom, and it pushed all my buttons.
sentences.zh: 那前七分钟就像是在课堂上一样，完全触动了我的痛点。

sentences.en: But Sam told me that it was like The Edge, and Sam told me that it was about best friendship.
sentences.zh: 但山姆告诉我这就像《边缘》，而且山姆告诉我这是关于最好的友谊的。

sentences.en: And so I stuck with it, and I watched it, and I loved it so much.
sentences.zh: 所以我坚持看了下去，我看了，而且我非常喜欢它。

sentences.en: Oh, I could cry right now.
sentences.zh: 噢，我现在都要感动哭了。

sentences.en: And lady, I see why you love this movie.
sentences.zh: 女士，我明白你为什么喜欢这部电影了。

sentences.en: First of all, elaborate birthday party.
sentences.zh: 首先，那场生日派对太讲究了。

sentences.en: The biggest birthday party in the Shire does the...
sentences.zh: 夏尔有史以来最盛大的生日派对，那场面……

sentences.en: Do they know how to throw a birthday or what?
sentences.zh: 他们是不是很会办派对？

sentences.en: Also, the hobbits on their journey, they eat giant hunks of cheese.
sentences.zh: 还有，霍比特人在旅途中，他们吃着一大块一大块的奶酪。
直接抓着一大把奶酪吃。

sentences.en: Yes, they bite right into it.

sentences.zh: 他们还要吃第二顿早餐。

sentences.en: And there are so many Matrix and Game of Thrones crossovers in this movie.
sentences.zh: 而且这部电影里有好多《黑客帝国》和《权力的游戏》的演员重合。

sentences.en: It's like there's one casting office for all these people.
sentences.zh: 感觉这些人好像都是同一个选角办公室挑出来的。
这简直是选角界的鼻祖。

sentences.en: The truest, when he jumps in the water, when Frodo's trying to row away.
sentences.zh: 最忠诚的，当弗罗多试图划船离开时，他跳进水里追过去。

sentences.en: Is that the movie where he gives Mr. Frodo the speech, where he's like, if you're not strong, I'll carry you?
sentences.zh: 那是他给弗罗多先生演讲的那部电影吗？就是他说，如果你不够坚强，我就背着你走的那段？
我觉得那是后面的剧情。

sentences.en: I'm on two towers now, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家，我现在正在看《双塔奇兵》呢。

sentences.en: Okay, so do you agree the orcs are scary?
sentences.zh: 好吧，那你同意半兽人很可怕吗？

sentences.en: Lady, not only are they scary.
It's very, this movie is very gruesome in a way I wasn't expecting.
sentences.zh: 这部电影非常血腥，程度超出了我的预期。

sentences.en: But like, here is the thing.
This movie is basically like a quest survivalist zombie film set in a fantasy world.
sentences.zh: 这部电影基本上就像是一部设定在奇幻世界的丧尸生存冒险片。

sentences.en: Like, it is like all the things that I love.
sentences.zh: 就像是我喜欢的所有元素的集合。
它还有点《终结者》的感觉。

sentences.en: There's being chased by this thing that can't be stopped.
sentences.zh: 那种被无法阻挡的东西追赶的感觉。
你知道，我的意思是，是的。

sentences.en: The only thing is like, I have to remember all the names of things.
sentences.zh: 唯一的问题是，我得记住所有事物的名称。

sentences.en: But there are a lot of names and terminology.
sentences.zh: 里面有很多专有名词和术语。
随着时间推移会变得容易些的。

sentences.en: They're very good at repeating it.
sentences.zh: 他们很擅长重复这些词。

sentences.en: To the Brotherhood of the Ring.
I can't believe you're here, Jenna.
sentences.zh: 真不敢相信你来了，珍娜。

sentences.en: Also, you guys know that when Jack, our son, watched these movies, he took it on himself.
sentences.zh: 另外，你们知道吗，当我们的儿子杰克看这些电影时，他主动承担了一件事。

sentences.en: And he was a young kid to learn elfish.
sentences.zh: 他当时还是个小孩子，就去学了精灵语。

sentences.en: And he also asked for his birthday for a Legolas wig.
sentences.zh: 而且他过生日时还想要一顶莱戈拉斯的假发。

sentences.en: And we had a little cubby by the front door where we would keep like volleyball and flip
sentences.zh: 我们前门有个小储物柜，平时放排球和人字拖。

sentences.en: And there was a wig tucked in there that would be spilling out right as you walk through the
sentences.zh: 里面塞着一顶假发，每次你走进前门时，它都会掉出来。

sentences.en: You keep your umbrellas, your bow and arrows.
sentences.zh: 你得把雨伞、弓箭放在那儿。

sentences.en: You keep it by the door.
And I would come home many days from work, and he'd be in the front yard with his suction
sentences.zh: 我下班回家时，经常看到他在前院玩耍，戴着莱戈拉斯的假发，拿着吸盘弓箭。

sentences.en: cup bow and arrow and his Legolas wig.
I mean, just what a delightful ragtag group of fellas.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这群家伙真是可爱又滑稽。

sentences.en: My friend, for his birthday, we got him a cameo from Sean Astin, who plays Sam.
sentences.zh: 我朋友过生日，我们给他买了一个肖恩·阿斯汀的视频祝福，就是演山姆的那位。

sentences.en: And it was the most feel-good cameo.
sentences.zh: 那真的是最让人暖心的祝福视频了。

sentences.en: Like, it inspired all of us, not just our friend.
sentences.zh: 它激励了我们所有人，不仅仅是我朋友。

sentences.en: But he was like, you have friends in the world that believe in you.
sentences.zh: 他说，在这个世界上，有朋友相信你。

sentences.en: Elijah Wood did a video for Jack.
sentences.zh: 伊利亚·伍德也给杰克录过视频。

sentences.en: I was working in Vancouver, and he was on a show there.
sentences.zh: 当时我在温哥华工作，他也在那儿拍戏。

sentences.en: And we were staying in the same sort of like furnished apartment building.
sentences.zh: 我们住的是同一种带家具的公寓楼。

sentences.en: And we would all go out together and hang out.
We went to a bar called, like, The Crow and watched Game of Thrones together.
sentences.zh: 我们去过一家叫“乌鸦”的酒吧，一起看《权力的游戏》。

sentences.en: And he did a video for Jack wishing him happy birthday.
sentences.zh: 他也给杰克录了视频，祝他生日快乐。

sentences.en: When I met both of them dressed as Big Titty Gandalf at LA Comic Con four years ago, I came
sentences.zh: 四年前在洛杉矶动漫展上，我打扮成“大胸甘道夫”去见他们俩，我刚转过拐角，

sentences.en: around the corner, and it was their first time seeing me.
sentences.zh: 那是他们第一次见到我。

sentences.en: And Elijah Wood looked at me, and he went, sure.
sentences.zh: 伊利亚·伍德看着我，说了句：好吧。

sentences.en: Sean Astin stopped me, and he goes, explain.
sentences.zh: 肖恩·阿斯汀拦住我，说：解释一下。

sentences.en: And I gave it like 30 seconds.
I was like, oh, it's a meme.
And then it was fine in his brain.
sentences.zh: 然后他脑子里就接受了这个设定。

sentences.en: I remember those pictures of you, Sam.
sentences.zh: 我记得你那些照片，山姆。

sentences.en: Well, that was my Friday chit-chat share, guys.
sentences.zh: 好了，这就是我周五想分享的闲聊，伙计们。

sentences.en: I've been waiting to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 我一直等着想聊这个呢。

sentences.en: You guys know in New Zealand, they have recreated the Shire.
sentences.zh: 你们知道在新西兰，他们重建了夏尔吗？

sentences.en: Well, you can walk the path that they walked.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你可以走他们走过的那条路。

sentences.en: It's like over a thousand miles or whatever.
sentences.zh: 大概有一千多英里长吧。

sentences.en: You can hike the Lord of the Rings path along where they filmed it.
sentences.zh: 你可以沿着他们拍摄《指环王》的路线徒步旅行。

sentences.en: No, not through the snowy mountains and not through the dragons or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 不，不是穿过雪山，也不是穿过巨龙什么的。

sentences.en: Yeah, but that'd be pretty cool.
And I feel like I would fit right in in the Shire.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我应该能完美融入夏尔。

sentences.en: I wouldn't have to duck going through the door.
sentences.zh: 我进门的时候都不用低头。

sentences.en: I'll go to walk through the Shire with you.
sentences.zh: 我陪你一起去夏尔走走。

sentences.en: Can we please do an office ladies trip to New Zealand?
sentences.zh: 我们能组织一次办公室姐妹团去新西兰旅行吗？

sentences.en: If we had a picture of the four of us, maybe with big walking sticks standing in the Shire.
sentences.zh: 如果我们四个人能拍张照，也许还能拿着大木棍站在夏尔里。

sentences.en: Sam in his costume, of course.
sentences.zh: 山姆当然得穿上他的戏服。

sentences.en: You might have to cover the titties up, Sam.
sentences.zh: 山姆，你可能得把胸部遮一遮。
因为它们完全露出来了。

sentences.en: Does anybody else have a share?
Nothing that can compete with that.
sentences.zh: 没什么能比得上那个了。

sentences.en: I have this observation about Josh.
So, you know, he hadn't had a new car in a very long time.
sentences.zh: 你们知道，他已经很久没换新车了。

sentences.en: We had the minivan with the kids for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我们开了很久那辆带孩子的面包车。

sentences.en: It's the people mover, you know, great car.
sentences.zh: 那是辆载人车，你知道的，很棒的车。

sentences.en: He finally got a new car.
And he washes it by himself in the driveway.
sentences.zh: 而且他还在车道上自己洗车。

sentences.en: And then I guess all the trees and all the things along the driveway are now blooming.
sentences.zh: 然后我猜车道旁所有的树和植物现在都开花了。

sentences.en: And every day, his car is covered in these little yellow pollen things.
sentences.zh: 每天，他的车上都覆盖着那些黄色的小花粉。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's that time of year for sure.
sentences.zh: 是啊，确实到了那个季节了。

sentences.en: And so, do you know what he did?
sentences.zh: 所以，你们知道他做了什么吗？

sentences.en: He went and he bought a floofy thing on a stick.
sentences.zh: 他去买了一个带杆子的毛茸茸的东西。

sentences.en: But like special for a car.
And I took a picture of him.
He doesn't know I took it out the front window.
sentences.zh: 他不知道我从前窗拍了他。

sentences.en: Every day, you guys, he's going out there and he's floofing his car.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，他每天都跑出去，在那儿给他的车掸灰。

sentences.en: I don't know what it's called.
But every day, he's got to go.

sentences.zh: 他很清楚自己喜欢什么。

sentences.en: Does he want to just get a car cover?
sentences.zh: 他难道就不能买个车罩吗？

sentences.en: Does he want to cover the car?
I think he likes the floofing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他喜欢那种掸灰的感觉。

sentences.en: I mean, the car cover seems like.
sentences.zh: 我是说，车罩看起来就像是……

sentences.en: I guess I'm going to let him floof.
sentences.zh: 我想我还是随他去掸吧。

sentences.en: I mean, he seems a bit obsessive about it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他在这件事上看起来有点强迫症。

sentences.en: Well, he's not like out there under like the full moon doing it, right?
sentences.zh: 好吧，他又不是在满月下做这件事，对吧？

sentences.en: No, he's just doing it several times a day.
sentences.zh: 不，他只是每天做几次而已。

sentences.en: And I'm like, it's going to get stuff on it, babe.
sentences.zh: 我就跟他说，亲爱的，这样反而会弄脏车。

sentences.en: I know it's a new car.
I know it's your new shiny thing.
sentences.zh: 我知道这是你的心头好。

sentences.en: We don't have a garage, you know, so we park outside.
sentences.zh: 你知道我们没有车库，所以只能停在外面。

sentences.en: Which is very common in LA.
There are not a lot of garages in LA.
The way our house was built, I should say, was built in 1936.
sentences.zh: 应该说，我们这房子是1936年建的。

sentences.en: And the way they did the garage was sort of in the back detached.
sentences.zh: 当时的车库是建在后面独立出来的。

sentences.en: And the driveway is so narrow because this house was built so long ago that you actually
sentences.zh: 而且车道特别窄，因为房子建得太久了，所以实际上

sentences.en: can't fit a modern size car.
sentences.zh: 根本停不进现代尺寸的汽车。

sentences.en: I don't know what they fit down this driveway.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们以前是怎么把车开进这条车道的。

sentences.en: Like basically an oversized lawnmower is what fits down it.
sentences.zh: 基本上也就只能开进去一台超大号的割草机。

sentences.en: So anyway, I was wondering, I was going to put it to the group and Josh listens to
sentences.zh: 总之，我在想，我本来想在群里问问，但乔什会听

sentences.en: the podcast because so he's going to be like, what the heck you sharing about my car?
sentences.zh: 播客，所以他肯定会说，你干嘛在节目里分享我的车的事？

sentences.en: Well, I'm going to say I love it, you know?
sentences.zh: 好吧，我会说我喜欢这样，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I think especially in today's age where I think sometimes as consumers, we can just be
sentences.zh: 我觉得特别是在当今这个时代，作为消费者，我们有时会变得

sentences.en: like, I don't know, very, what do you call it?
Like, just kind of like throwaway culture, you know?
sentences.zh: 就是那种“用完即弃”的文化，你懂吗？

sentences.en: I love when someone takes care of something and care with something.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢看到有人能爱惜物品，用心呵护。

sentences.en: It reminds me of my dad.
This is a very, yeah, it reminds me, yeah.
sentences.zh: 这确实，没错，让我想起了他。

sentences.en: I would say just keep a watch.
sentences.zh: 我会说，你就先观察一下。

sentences.en: When it gets to 10 times a day, that's too many.
sentences.zh: 如果一天超过10次，那就太多了。

sentences.en: Angela, can you do an experiment for us?
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，你能为我们做一个实验吗？

sentences.en: One day, can you go out and flip the car and see how he reacts?
sentences.zh: 哪天你出去帮他掸车，看看他会有什么反应？

sentences.en: Like maybe, I'm curious how he reacts.
sentences.zh: 也许吧，我很好奇他会有什么反应。

sentences.en: He did just buy a very special little, like, it's like a trash bag and a holder that attaches
sentences.zh: 他刚买了一个很特别的小东西，就像是一个垃圾袋和配套的支架，可以挂在

sentences.en: to the back of the seat.
If you have like a granola bar wrapper or anything, it's got to go in that little caddy
sentences.zh: 如果你有燕麦棒包装纸之类的东西，必须扔进那个挂在

sentences.en: attached to the back of the seat.
You guys, he's loving this car.
Because he's ready to have an adult car again.
sentences.zh: 因为他准备好重新拥有一辆成年人的车了。

sentences.en: He's ready to have a car that is like clean and doesn't have all the like little kid
sentences.zh: 他准备好拥有一辆干净整洁，没有那些小孩子

sentences.en: And every time you get in it and turn it on and turn it off, the dashboard lights up and
sentences.zh: 而且每次你上车，发动再熄火，仪表盘就会亮起来，

sentences.en: it goes, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, like it does.
sentences.zh: 发出砰、砰、砰、砰、砰、砰的声音，就是那样。

sentences.en: And he's like so tickled by it.
Anyway, you guys, that's my Friday chit chat.
sentences.zh: 总之，伙计们，这就是我周五的闲聊。

sentences.en: My husband is real happy with his new car.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫对他的新车非常满意。

sentences.en: I have a second Friday chit chat, which is that I've been fostering some kittens through
sentences.zh: 我还有第二个周五闲聊话题，就是我一直在通过
小猫救援组织寄养一些小猫。

sentences.en: And I need them to be adopted.
sentences.zh: 我需要帮它们找到领养人。

sentences.en: So we have four kittens, an adult cat and a dog.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在有四只小猫、一只成年猫和一只狗。

sentences.en: And so we have six animals.
There's only four people in the house.
And speaking of like zombies, these kittens, it's a little bit like living in a zombie movie
sentences.zh: 说到僵尸，这些小猫，生活在它们中间有点像住在僵尸电影里，

sentences.en: But then if you come upstairs and you like creak the floor, all their little heads pop up.
sentences.zh: 但如果你上楼弄出地板吱呀声，它们的小脑袋就会齐刷刷地抬起来。

sentences.en: And then they all like slowly start walking towards you.
sentences.zh: 然后它们会一起慢慢朝你走过来。

sentences.en: But then they also are like both four separate things and also one organism.
sentences.zh: 但它们既是四个独立的个体，又像是一个整体生物。

sentences.en: So it's like they can do things.
sentences.zh: 所以它们能做出各种举动。

sentences.en: They can cover such a wide area with their mayhem.
sentences.zh: 它们能用捣乱覆盖如此广的区域。

sentences.en: And then they all come back together.
sentences.zh: 然后它们又会聚在一起。

sentences.en: And then they all come back together.
It's like the fungus in The Last of Us.
sentences.zh: 就像《最后生还者》里的真菌一样。

sentences.en: Anyway, please go to kittenrescue.org and fill out a adoption form.
sentences.zh: 总之，请访问 kittenrescue.org 并填写领养申请表。

sentences.en: Please adopt these kittens if you live in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 如果你住在洛杉矶，请领养这些小猫。

sentences.en: Their names are Manny, Claire, Haley, and Chinny D, aka Phil, aka Chin Dot.
sentences.zh: 它们的名字叫曼尼、克莱尔、海莉和下巴D，又名菲尔，又名下巴点点。

sentences.en: He's got a dot on his chin.
We started calling him Chin Dot.
sentences.zh: 我们开始叫他“下巴点点”。

sentences.en: And then that he's now Chinny D.
And also, I think one of the things that tickled me the most about today,
sentences.zh: 还有，我觉得今天最让我觉得好笑的一件事是，

sentences.en: we've been in the studio for a while, is that when Sam said,
sentences.zh: 我们在录音室待了一会儿，当山姆说，

sentences.en: oh, like the fungus on The Last of Us, Cassie went, aww.
sentences.zh: 哦，就像《最后生还者》里的真菌一样，凯西竟然说，噢。

sentences.en: I'm just thinking of these little kittens, you know, being little zombies.
sentences.zh: 我只是在想这些小猫，你知道的，变成小僵尸的样子。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to Office Ladies.
Office Ladies is a presentation of Odyssey and is produced by Jenna Fisher and Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 《办公室女士》由 Odyssey 出品，珍娜·费舍尔和安吉拉·金赛制作。

sentences.en: Our executive producer is Cassie Jerkins.
sentences.zh: 我们的执行制片人是凯西·杰金斯。

sentences.en: Our audio engineer is Sam Kiefer.
sentences.zh: 我们的音频工程师是山姆·基弗。

sentences.en: And our associate producer is Ainsley Bubbico.
sentences.zh: 我们的助理制片人是安斯利·布比科。

sentences.en: Odyssey's executive producer is Leah Reese Dennis.
sentences.zh: Odyssey 的执行制片人是莉亚·里斯·丹尼斯。

sentences.en: Office Ladies was mixed and mastered by Bill Schultz.
sentences.zh: 《办公室女士》由比尔·舒尔茨进行混音和母带处理。

sentences.en: Our theme song is Rubber Tree by Creed Bratton.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲是克里德·布拉顿演唱的《橡胶树》。
